comments.author: @FreeER
comments.text:
Hmmm. Nice improvement. I mean they both generate shit in different ways, but at least "3.0" lools like it's more complicated shit 😂 

The main difference shown is that "3d" in 2.5 just meant well 3 dimensions (think Lego model) while in "3.0" it took that further to actually movement around those axis. Hence the difference in the colosseum, moon, and boxing ring. Honestly the 3.0 colosseum looked like shit to me but it was semi playable shit vs a horrible drawing\Lego set. The moon was honestly more functional in 2.5 with rotation and visible fuel use that didn't expense itself in half a second lol but 3.0 did add more dimensional depth to the terrain (though not the lander). And the boxer, eg the floating metal blocks were shitty hands BUT they were animated unlike 2.5 not showing them, and there was some "real" hit effects with the opponents head however it didn't look like any actually damage got done where you could "win" let alone have the opponent fight back. 


It's still a question about how much it might fight you trying to make changes over a longer project (like making a complete game) and certainly isn't one shotting them, but it's also undeniable that it's clearly TRYING to do a bit more "out of the box" so to speak.
